architecture: BIO structured-perceptron span tagger + averaged-perceptron archetype classifier + ontology grounding (D-034a)
heldOutSet: eval/briefs.jsonl (99 briefs; used during development, scores are optimistic)
freshHoldoutSet: eval/holdout2.jsonl (40 briefs; written after tuning stopped, never tuned against)
knownLimitations: Entity extraction on unseen phrasing is weak (fresh-holdout entity F1 about 0.58): synonyms such as "practitioner" vs "staff member" and domain nouns missing from the ontology are often missed or mislabelled.
Every interpretation is shown to the user in the Review step before anything is composed; entities, screens and product type are all editable there.
